messages:
anna-partnerships: Quick check-in on marketplace onboarding items. Need final answers for: SKU schema, trial entitlement config, whether we include BYOL now, and the minimal artifact set for each cloud.

tom-aws: AWS prefers either AMI or container. If AMI, include a public AMI id and health check. Metering requires a role or SaaS connector.

sara-gcp: GCP wants a container in GCR or a disk image in GCE. Also needs a service account with compute.imageUser and metering write permission.

mike-legal: Recommend GA list only subscription (no BYOL). I'll prepare marketplace addendum and trial T&Cs for 30-day trial.

jess-product: Agreed on subscription-first. SKU format suggestion: redwood.dedicated.v1.<region>. Keep it short. Packaging = tar.gz with install script + quickstart and a helm chart for containers.

marketplace-integ-bot: Reminder: vendor registration and banking info required for AWS; allow 3 business days for verification. Docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/marketplace/onboarding

anna-partnerships: Actions: Tom/Sara drop AMI/container URIs + region matrix by tomorrow noon; Mike uploads addendum; Jess uploads artifact tarball + pricing matrix. I'll submit once all assets present.

tom-aws: Will post AMI id and minimal IAM policy: {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["marketplace:MeterUsage","sts:AssumeRole"],"Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-marketplace"}]}

sara-gcp: GCR path will be gcr.io/redwood-marketplace/redwood-dedicated:v1. Will share service account name.

mike-legal: Uploaded draft: https://internal.redwood/legal/marketplace-addendum-draft-v2.pdf — please flag edits.

anna-partnerships: Great, aiming to submit by EOD Tuesday. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
